none: PAS NCL-369E56: NCL-369E56: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A lead sealing dating to the Roman period. The sealing is rectangular in shape and section. On its obverse is a stamped rectangular die, within which is the legend '[V]NOV'. The underside of the sealing appears to be plain. The sealing is pierced horizontally as evidenced by two perforations in the section of the sealing.
